top_signals.title: US Futures Slip as Neocloud IPO Elice Flops, SpaceX Results Loom
top_signals.summary: The return of artificial-intelligence angst pushed Nasdaq futures lower on Tuesday, as South Korean neocloud company Elice Inc.’s debut tanked, spurring concern about the sustainability of the global AI boom. Investors are also on edge ahead of a spate of tech earnings this week, including SpaceX and Netflix Inc. after the bell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Apple adds U.S. titanium supplier for iPhone Duo as supply stays tight
top_signals.summary: Apple is adding a U.S. titanium supplier for its new iPhone Duo and expanding domestic production of camera components for the iPhone 18 Pro.
